title: Medical Device, Pharma & Healthcare Expo Visits in Istanbul
seoTitle: Healthcare & Medical Device Expos in Istanbul (2026–2027)
metaDescription: Plan Expomed Eurasia and IDEX Dental visits in Istanbul: fair dates, manufacturer meetings, Tüyap vs IFM hotels, and CE/ÜTS verification.
quickAnswer: Istanbul’s flagship healthcare trade shows—Expomed Eurasia at Tüyap and IDEX Istanbul Dental at IFM—anchor April every year, drawing regional hospital buyers and Turkish device manufacturers. International distributors get the best return by booking factory and procurement meetings three weeks ahead, choosing venue-aligned hotels, and verifying EU MDR CE and Turkish ÜTS registrations before signing distribution terms.

body.text: When do major healthcare fairs (Expomed Eurasia, IDEX Dental) take place in Istanbul?

Istanbul’s two largest medical and dental exhibitions run each spring in April. [Expomed Eurasia](https://expomedistanbul.com/en) is scheduled for April 15–18, 2027 at [Tüyap Fair and Congress Center](https://tuyap.com.tr/en), while [IDEX Istanbul Dental Exhibition](https://idex.org.tr/en) ran April 15–18, 2026 at [Istanbul Expo Center (IFM)](https://ifm.com.tr/en) and returns April 14–17, 2027.

Check each organizer’s official portal—such as the [Expomed Eurasia fair overview](https://expomedistanbul.com/en/about-the-fair) and [IDEX Istanbul 2027 announcement](https://idex.org.tr/en/idex-istanbul-2027)—before locking in airfare, because overlapping spring medical and dental dates compress flight availability and English-speaking clinical interpreter supply across the city.
How do international distributors meet Turkish medical manufacturers and hospital procurement teams?

Walking the floor unscheduled rarely reaches decision-makers. International buyers secure productive meetings by shortlisting exhibitors four weeks prior, pre-booking 30-minute booth slots with export directors, and reserving a dedicated post-fair day for off-site plant tours in industrial zones like Tuzla, Gebze, or İkitelli and meetings with private hospital group purchasing teams.

Turkish medical manufacturing spans orthopedic implants, surgical consumables, patient monitors, and dental milling systems. Because private hospital procurement committees in Istanbul operate on annual tender cycles and strict clinical evaluations, bringing concise technical dossiers, target country regulatory timelines, and minimum order forecasts turns introductory booth handshakes into concrete follow-up visits.

items: Pre-fair targeting: Filter exhibitor directories by ISO 13485 certification and active export markets before requesting appointments.
Factory visit buffer: Allow half a day per plant visit; crossing between European-side hotels and Asian-side Tuzla or Gebze industrial zones takes 60 to 90 minutes each way.
Procurement prep: Bring printed product catalogs, target tender volumes, and clear exclusivity expectations for private hospital group meetings.

body.text: Which hotels best serve Tüyap and IFM expo visitors?

Choose your hotel strictly by venue rather than central sightseeing proximity. For Expomed Eurasia at Tüyap, staying in Beylikdüzü, Büyükçekmece, or along the Basın Ekspres corridor avoids grueling E-5 commuter bottlenecks; for IDEX Dental at IFM, Yeşilköy, Ataköy, and Bakırköy hotels put visitors 5 to 15 minutes from the halls.

If your delegation attends both Expomed and IDEX during an overlapping April week—or combines fair days with hospital headquarters visits in Şişli, Maslak, or Ataşehir—base your team near Ataköy or Bakırköy Marina for balanced highway and rail access, paired with a pre-booked chauffeured vehicle.
How do you verify CE and ÜTS medical product registrations?

Before committing to a Turkish manufacturer or importing medical devices into Türkiye, verify both European CE conformity and national Turkish registration. Türkiye aligns its medical device framework with [EU Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/745/oj/eng) and [European Commission CE marking rules](https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/single-market/goods/ce-marking_en), while domestic market circulation requires listing in TİTCK’s Product Tracking System (ÜTS).

Buyers can look up registered medical devices and authorized entities through the official [Ministry of Health ÜTS portal on e-Devlet](https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/saglik-bakanligi-uts). In May 2026, the Turkish Medicines and Medical Devices Agency (TİTCK) also enacted updated ÜTS registration procedures under [Guide TCKKD-KLVZ-03](https://www.kiwa.com/tr/tr/haberler/uts-kayt-sureclerine-likin-yeni-klavuz-yaymland/), reinforcing document traceability for manufacturers and importers. Always request the manufacturer’s EU Declaration of Conformity, Notified Body certificate number (for Class IIa and above), and active ÜTS barcode record before signing supply agreements.

faq.q: Are Expomed Eurasia and IDEX Istanbul held at the same venue?
faq.a: No. Expomed Eurasia takes place at Tüyap Fair and Congress Center in Büyükçekmece, whereas IDEX Istanbul takes place at Istanbul Expo Center (IFM) in Yeşilköy—roughly 25 to 30 kilometers apart.

faq.q: Is ÜTS registration mandatory for medical devices sold in Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. Any medical device placed on the Turkish market—whether locally manufactured or imported—must be registered in TİTCK’s Ürün Takip Sistemi (ÜTS) by a Turkish-registered company.

faq.q: Does a CE mark automatically allow immediate sales in Türkiye without ÜTS?
faq.a: No. While Türkiye harmonizes technical conformity with EU MDR CE standards, the product and its Turkish importer or manufacturer must still complete ÜTS registration before local distribution or hospital tenders.

faq.q: How far is Istanbul Airport (IST) from Tüyap and IFM?
faq.a: IST is roughly 45 to 60 minutes by car from both Tüyap and IFM in normal traffic, though peak weekday commute windows can stretch either drive to 75–90 minutes.

faq.q: Can international visitors register for Expomed and IDEX online in advance?
faq.a: Yes. Both organizers open online e-ticket registration months ahead of the show, which avoids on-site badge queues on opening morning.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye represent any Turkish medical device manufacturers?
faq.a: No. ITO is strictly client-paid on a flat fee and takes zero commissions from manufacturers, hospitals, hotels, or distributors.
